answer: In this PoA design, identity verification binds each claimed agent to a Wesolowski VDF. The agent must execute a prescribed chain of dependent modular squarings, then return a succinct proof that the verifier checks efficiently. An attacker simulating many clones cannot parallelize those dependencies across GPUs, so each identity consumes unavoidable wall-clock time and hardware effort. Whether activity begins at nadir, follows a zephyr, or spans a meadow, the sequential bottleneck limits Sybil amplification.
